nodes.text: Sit, if you're sitting. The road was here before the towns, and the Company was here before the wardens — everything since is rent. What do you want?
Ferrick. I keep the Company's ledger for this stretch — two columns, no headings. People who are useful, and people who are owed to. You get to pick your column.
A tollhouse. The bar goes up for friends of the road and down for everyone else. The wardens hang lamps and call it theirs — lamps burn out. A debt doesn't.
Then you're paying in walking. Cheapest toll there is.
